privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introBody: AI-tinerary («we») respects your privacy. This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it, and who we share it with when you use the web and mobile app.
privacy.dataCollectedBody:
• Email and profile (if you sign in with Google or email/password)
• Travel itineraries you create or edit
• Language preference
• Basic technical data (server logs, IP address for security)
privacy.dataUseBody:
We use your data to:
• Authenticate you and sync trips across devices
• Generate and translate itineraries with AI
• Show maps, weather and activity images
• Improve service reliability and security
privacy.thirdPartiesBody:
We share data with providers that help us deliver the service:
• Supabase (authentication and database)
• Google Gemini, Groq and other AI providers (text generation)
• Open-Meteo (weather)
• OpenStreetMap / Nominatim (geocoding)
• OpenFreeMap (maps)

We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.storageBody: Registered users' trips are stored on Supabase until you delete them or delete your account. Guests can save trips locally on the device only (localStorage).
privacy.rightsBody: You can delete individual trips from the app. If you have an account, you can delete it from the Account page: your account, trips and share links will be removed. For GDPR requests contact us at the email below.
privacy.contactBody:
For privacy questions email: privacy@ai-tinerary.app

Replace this address with the real data controller email before publishing on the stores.
